outcome.uncertain: We could not confirm whether this answer was recorded. Your attempted answer is preserved. Check status; do not submit it again.
outcome.stillOpen: The request still appears open, but the earlier answer may still finish. Keep checking status; do not submit again.
outcome.conflict: A different result is recorded: {{option}}. Your attempted answer was {{attempted}}.

outcome.defaultPending: The default is still recorded. Your later answer may still finish. Check status; do not submit again.
outcome.allDone: That was the last decision waiting for you.
outcome.changed: The requester updated this decision while you were answering, so nothing was sent. It has been reloaded and your draft is kept. Check it against what changed, then send again.

viewer.changed: This file changed after the agent asked. You are looking at the copy the agent attached.
viewer.missing: The original file no longer exists. You are looking at the copy the agent attached.

rootPassword.checkFailed: Could not check the decision. Try checking again before sending another answer.
rootPassword.unclear: The result is unclear. Check the decision before trying again.
rootPassword.invalid: Authentication failed. Check your credentials and try again.
rootPassword.unavailable: The decision changed or is no longer available. Return to review it again.
rootPassword.uncertain: The answer may or may not have been recorded. Check its status before trying again.

rootRead.title: Read this decision
rootRead.intro: Verify your authenticator account to read this decision. Answering requires a separate verification.
